description: This Java class 'ResourceModifiedStrategy' handles ResourceModified events within the Eclipse Ditto policies persistence framework. It extends an abstract strategy class and applies event handling logic to modify policy builders based on resource modification events.

classes.name: ResourceModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractPolicyEventStrategy to handle ResourceModified events by updating policy builders.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to process ResourceModified events and update the PolicyBuilder with the modified resource.
